cassia.predicted_cell_type: Dendritic cell (DC), specifically plasmacytoid dendritic cell (pDC)
strengths: Correctly identifies the pDC lineage using canonical pDC markers CLEC4C, LILRA4, IL3RA, TCF4, IRF7
Acknowledges that JCHAIN/MZB1/DERL3/NAPSB reflect the plasmacytoid program rather than plasma-cell identity
Rules out cDC1/cDC2/basophils with appropriate negative markers
weaknesses: Mapped to broad CL:0000451 (dendritic cell) instead of the direct pDC term CL:0000784 despite the label explicitly specifying pDC
No dedicated CLID for pDC in its own mapping; verifier_review needed

strengths: Consistent with the dendritic cell lineage; top-2 includes plasmacytoid dendritic cell with high score
Deterministic mapping to a valid ontology term
weaknesses: Top1 stops at the ancestral term CL:0000451 rather than the most specific supported descendant CL:0000784
Under-annotates specificity despite the same marker set supporting pDC

strengths: Correctly prioritizes specific pDC markers LILRA4, CLEC4C, IL3RA, SLC15A4, IRF7, TCF4, GZMB, PTCRA
Explains shared B-cell markers (JCHAIN, MZB1, DERL3) without misclassifying as plasma cell
weaknesses: Relies on a marker-panel subset rather than full DEG ranking
Enrichment terms alone were non-informative, but this does not affect the final call given strong marker support

supporting: Positive DEGs include canonical pDC markers CLEC4C (BDCA-2), LILRA4 (ILT7), IL3RA (CD123), GZMB, PTCRA, SERPINF1, GAS6, SLC15A4, DNASE1L3, SCT, SHD
pDC lineage transcription factors TCF4 and IRF7 are present in the original DEG list, with IRF8, BCL11A, and IRF4 as supporting regulators
Enrichment terms include interferon-alpha production, TLR7/8 and TLR9 cascades, consistent with pDC function
JCHAIN, MZB1, DERL3, NAPSB are explained by the plasmacytoid transcriptional program and do not indicate plasma-cell contamination in the absence of SDC1/TNFRSF17/XBP1/immunoglobulin evidence
conflicting: Shared markers with B cells/plasma cells (JCHAIN, MZB1, DERL3, NAPSB) are present but are consistent with known pDC biology
FCER1A and LGMN could suggest cDC2 but are outweighed by the pDC-specific combination LILRA4+CLEC4C+IL3RA+TCF4+IRF7
enrichment_or_literature: Interferon-alpha production and regulation of interferon-alpha production
PMID 36658547, 36544104, 34910688, 36233633, 34899743, 36276113, 37006239 support pDC identity and marker interpretation

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
